newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Powerboat gets $10 mln of orders.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Powerboat gets $10 mln of orders.

text.p: Fountain Powerboat Industries Inc said on Thursday it received final sales orders for 104 boats, valued at more than $10 million, at the Miami boat show.
This compares to 40 boats ordered in the prior year, Fountain Powerboat said.
The Miami show is important in that it kicks off the seasonal sales cycle for Fountain and is usually indicative of sales momentum throughout the selling season, the company said.
Fountain Powerboat said its sales goal was 50 boats at the February 13-20 show.
Fountain Powerboat reported $41.6 million in annual sales for the year ended June 1996.
Fountain Powerboat shares were up three points at 23-3/4 at mid-morning.
